scenarios.title: A｜决定去哪
scenarios.setting: 两个人见面后，还没有完全决定接下来做什么。

turns.text: So, what do you feel like doing?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一次约会」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: How about getting something to eat first?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about getting something to eat first?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: There’s a café nearby I’ve been wanting to try.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a café nearby I’ve been wanting to try.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: We could grab a drink and then walk around for a bit.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could grab a drink and then walk around for a bit.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m pretty flexible. Is there anywhere you want to go?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m pretty flexible. Is there anywhere you want to go?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Where do you want that we go?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about getting something to eat first?
feedback.explanation: “want”后可用“us to go”；问一起去哪里可说“Where would you like to go?”，不接“that we go”。

turns.text: I’m kind of hungry. Food sounds good.

turns.prompt: 你想了解对方想吃什么，便于一起选地点，会怎么说？

choices.text: What kind of food are you in the mood for?

feedback.naturalExpression: What kind of food are you in the mood for?
feedback.explanation: “kind of”口语中表示有点、算是，常用来缓和对自身或事情的描述。

choices.text: Do you have any preferences?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any preferences?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: There’s a Japanese place nearby. How does that sound?

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a Japanese place nearby. How does that sound?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Are you okay with something casual?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you okay with something casual?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.prompt: 你想回应提议，并补充地点距离，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. It’s only about five minutes from here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. It’s only about five minutes from here.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Great. Let’s head over there, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s head over there, then.
feedback.explanation: “head over”表示前往某处，是口语中说明马上过去的说法。

choices.text: Nice. I’ve heard their food is really good.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nice. I’ve heard their food is really good.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

scenarios.title: B｜聊兴趣爱好
scenarios.setting: 吃饭时，两个人开始聊平时喜欢做什么。

turns.text: So what do you usually do for fun?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一次约会」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I draw a lot, and I play video games when I have time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I draw a lot, and I play video games when I have time.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I’m really into movies and games. How about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really into movies and games. How about you?
feedback.explanation: “really into”表示对某事感兴趣，可以接具体爱好来展开聊天。

choices.text: I like exploring new places, although I don’t get out as much as I’d like.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like exploring new places, although I don’t get out as much as I’d like.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: Honestly, I’m kind of a homebody. I like staying in and watching movies.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I’m kind of a homebody. I like staying in and watching movies.
feedback.explanation: “homebody”指喜欢待在家里的人，是介绍生活方式的口语词。

choices.text: My hobbies are drawing and play games.

feedback.naturalExpression: I draw a lot, and I play video games when I have time.
feedback.explanation: 并列的爱好要保持形式一致，应说“drawing and playing games”。

turns.text: I’m a bit of a homebody too. What kind of games do you play?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一次约会」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Mostly single-player and story-driven games.

feedback.naturalExpression: Mostly single-player and story-driven games.
feedback.explanation: “story-driven”说明游戏偏重剧情或单人体验，比只说喜欢游戏更有话题可聊。

choices.text: I really like games with a strong story and atmosphere.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really like games with a strong story and atmosphere.
feedback.explanation: 具体说喜欢故事和氛围好的游戏，给对方推荐或追问留下话题。

choices.text: A little bit of everything, but I’m not very competitive.

feedback.naturalExpression: A little bit of everything, but I’m not very competitive.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I’ve been playing a lot of puzzle games lately.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been playing a lot of puzzle games lately.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

turns.text: I’m terrible at competitive games too.

turns.prompt: 你想接住共同兴趣的话题，轻松聊下去，会怎么说？

choices.text: Good, then we won’t have to compete!

feedback.naturalExpression: Good, then we won’t have to compete!
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Same. I play games to relax, not to get stressed out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Same. I play games to relax, not to get stressed out.
feedback.explanation: 用“to relax”说明玩游戏的目的，再与压力作对照，清楚表达自己的偏好。

choices.text: Maybe we have more in common than I thought.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we have more in common than I thought.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

scenarios.title: C｜聊彼此经历
scenarios.setting: 在“第一次约会”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“聊彼此经历”。

turns.prompt: 你想介绍自己的来处或生活经历，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, I moved here a couple of years ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I moved here a couple of years ago.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: Pretty much. I grew up here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Pretty much. I grew up here.
feedback.explanation: “grew up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: I grew up somewhere else and moved here for work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I grew up somewhere else and moved here for work.
feedback.explanation: “grew up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: No. I’ve moved around quite a bit, actually.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I’ve moved around quite a bit, actually.
feedback.explanation: “quite a bit”表示相当多或不少，适合口语中描述程度。

choices.text: No, I live here since two years ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I moved here a couple of years ago.
feedback.explanation: 从两年前住到现在用现在完成时：“I’ve lived here for two years”；“since”后也可接开始的时间点。

turns.prompt: 你想说明当初搬来的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Mostly work. I got a job here and decided to give it a try.

feedback.naturalExpression: Mostly work. I got a job here and decided to give it a try.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: I wanted a change and thought it would be a good experience.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted a change and thought it would be a good experience.
feedback.explanation: 先说想换个环境，再补充期待获得的体验，让搬来的原因更完整。

choices.text: I originally came here for school and ended up staying.

feedback.naturalExpression: I originally came here for school and ended up staying.
feedback.explanation: “ended up”表示最终结果，常用于说明事情后来发展成了什么样。

choices.text: A few different things, really. Work was probably the biggest reason.

feedback.naturalExpression: A few different things, really. Work was probably the biggest reason.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

turns.text: Do you think you’ll stay here long-term?

turns.prompt: 你想表达自己对未来去留还没有决定，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m not sure yet. I’m pretty happy here for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure yet. I’m pretty happy here for now.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: Maybe. I haven’t really decided what I want to do long-term.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe. I haven’t really decided what I want to do long-term.
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: I think so. I’ve built a pretty good life here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think so. I’ve built a pretty good life here.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Probably not forever. I’d like to live somewhere else at some point.

feedback.naturalExpression: Probably not forever. I’d like to live somewhere else at some point.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.text: Yeah, I know what you mean. I haven’t figured that out either.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方也还在摸索的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: I guess we don’t have to have everything figured out yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I guess we don’t have to have everything figured out yet.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Exactly. Sometimes it’s nice just to see where things go.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. Sometimes it’s nice just to see where things go.
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: Yeah. A lot can change in a few years.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. A lot can change in a few years.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。
